title: Sliding One Log Along Another
summary: A tree ring is a year. Slide an undated timber along a dated chronology until the pattern locks and you have dated it to the year, until the noise wins and the lock is a confident lie.

sources.title: Douglass, Crossdating in Dendrochronology, Journal of Forestry 39 (1941)
Cook and Kairiukstis (eds), Methods of Dendrochronology (Kluwer, 1990), chapters on standardisation and crossdating
